title: Transaction Management
summary: Ensuring data consistency by grouping operations into atomic units with ACID properties and isolation levels.

content.overview: Transactions ensure data consistency by grouping operations into atomic units.
content.details: ACID properties: Atomicity (all or nothing), Consistency (valid state transitions), Isolation (concurrent transactions don't interfere), Durability (committed data persists). Isolation levels: READ UNCOMMITTED, READ COMMITTED (default in most databases), REPEATABLE READ, and SERIALIZABLE.
